title: Regional Bridge Orchestrator: health synthesis and graceful degradation protocol
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a Regional Bridge Orchestrator service that continuously synthesizes health signals across regions and tiers and executes graceful degradation when required. This ticket covers: (1) a health synthesis layer that aggregates probes (latency, error rate, KV cache hit fraction, model warmness) into a single region readiness score; (2) a policy engine that maps readiness scores to routing actions (weighted shift, rationing, emergency fallback to cheaper model variant); and (3) a preflight/canary path to warm fallback variants with minimal disruption.
acceptance_criteria: Synthesis engine computes a per-region readiness score every 10s combining latency P95, 1m error rate, KV cache hit ratio, and model cold-start rate
Policy engine translates score thresholds into actions: normal routing, throttled routing, partial drain with canary, and full failover to fallback model variant
Automated preflight warms fallback variant and validates correctness by replaying sampled requests before broad traffic shift
Runbook and console dashboard show region readiness timeline and last-triggered policy action
End-to-end e2e test can simulate region degradation and verify rollback within SLA bounds
tasks: Design readiness scoring formula (weights, smoothing, outlier handling)
Implement probe adapters (latency/error/cache/warmness) and local aggregation
Policy engine: threshold config, hysteresis, and gradual weight migration
Fallback variant warming flow (shadow traffic + sampled validation)
Console dashboard and telemetry hooks (readiness timeline, event audit)
E2E chaos test to validate failure and rollback behavior
Docs: runbook, API spec, and postmortem checklist
progress_updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff meeting; agreed on high-level API shape for readiness scores and policy actions (notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/REG-bridge-design)
2026-03-01: Prototype readiness scorer implemented in local harness. Uses exponential moving average for latency and a weighted sum for signals. Observed noisy spikes during KV cache rebuilds.
2026-03-03: Decision: add cache-priming-aware smoothing window and decouple cold-start signal to avoid thrashing between canary and full failover (design doc updated).
2026-03-05: Policy engine stub merged on feature branch; includes hysteresis and progressive weight migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/4121
2026-03-07: Integration test showing warm fallback by shadowing 5% traffic to q4-approximate variant. Validation logic flags regressions when semantic mismatch > 2% on sample prompts (tunable).
2026-03-09: Observability events added; console panel prototype live at /console/ops/region-readiness. Need UX feedback from Console PM before rollout
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Deploy scorer and policy engine in read-only mode (no action) to collect baseline for 72h
Stage 2: Enable dry-run policy actions (log only) for next 48h; validate alerts and dashboard
Stage 3: Enable progressive migration for low-risk region pairs (10% traffic shift over 5 minutes) with active rollback on validation failures
Stage 4: Full enablement and include fallback warming for all critical regions; monitor 24/7 during initial 72h
risks: Incorrect readiness weighting can trigger unnecessary failovers causing higher latency/cost
KV cache rebuilds may correlate across regions during large deployments and create noisy signals
Fallback variant semantic mismatch could silently degrade UX if validation sample is not representative
Policy bugs could cause oscillation between regions if hysteresis is misconfigured
test_plan: Unit tests for scorer math and probe adapters
Integration tests simulating KV cache heat/cold cycles and ensuring smoothing prevents thrash
Chaos scenario: simulate region network partition and assert policy achieves failover within SLO (<= 30s weighted migration start)
A/B validation harness to compare fallback variant outputs on a held prompt set
dependencies: ENG-412345 (kv-cache-observability): KV cache instrumentation with per-shard hit ratios
ENG-531001 (console-readouts): Console metrics panel and audit events
PM-998: Policy config UI and RBAC gates
notes: Design trade-off: favor conservative thresholds initially; customers prefer availability over occasional higher-cost fallback
Follow-up: schedule a tabletop incident exercise with SRE and Account teams after Stage 3 rollout
UX ask: show last successful fallback validation sample in console to help on-call triage
